title.zh: 賽局理論與不對稱戰略談判 (CEO/首席談判官 視角)
title.en: Game Theory & Asymmetric Negotiation Strategy (CEO/CNO Perspective)

slide_title.zh: 囚徒困境與毀滅性競爭 (SCQA & The Game Theory Mandate)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：在目前的 [市場/併購/供應鏈] 談判中，我們與對手陷入了高度的不信任，雙方都在採取防禦性或攻擊性的短期策略
衝突 (Complication)：這種典型的「囚徒困境 (Prisoner's Dilemma)」導致了毀滅性的價格戰與資源消耗，雙方都朝著最差的「納許均衡 (Nash Equilibrium)」墜落
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：提議捨棄傳統的「直覺式談判」，全面導入「賽局理論 (Game Theory)」，懇請授權透過改變遊戲規則與報償矩陣，強制解開死結
en: Situation: In our current [Market/M&A/Supply Chain] negotiations, we are locked in a state of acute mutual distrust, with both sides deploying defensive or aggressively short-term tactics.
Complication: This classic 'Prisoner's Dilemma' is triggering a destructive price war and resource attrition, driving both parties toward the worst possible 'Nash Equilibrium.'

The Ask: Proposing a pivot from intuitive bargaining to rigorous 'Game Theory' architecture. Requesting the mandate to structurally alter the rules of engagement and payoff matrices to force a deadlock resolution.

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事，我們現在面臨的不是單純的商業競爭，而是一場經典的『囚徒困境』。因為互不信任，我們跟對手都在流血降價，最後的結果就是雙雙破產。這在賽局理論中叫做最差的『納許均衡』。傳統的喊話跟公關已經無效了。今天的提案，是要用數學跟邏輯的視角來重新設計這場談判，我們不只要贏，還要贏得有科學根據。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, we are not merely facing commercial competition; we are trapped in a classic 'Prisoner's Dilemma.' Driven by mutual distrust, both we and our rivals are bleeding out in a price war. Mathematically, we are accelerating toward a catastrophic 'Nash Equilibrium.' Traditional PR and intuitive bargaining have failed. Today's mandate weaponizes Game Theory to fundamentally redesign the negotiation architecture. We will not just win; we will win with scientific certainty.

slide_title.zh: 解構談判籌碼：BATNA 與不對稱槓桿 (BATNA & Leverage)

zh: 最佳替代方案 (BATNA)：在走上談判桌前，必須冷酷精算出我們的 BATNA（若談判破裂，我們最好的退路是什麼）。BATNA 越強，談判底氣越硬
摧毀對手的退路 (Degrading Opponent's BATNA)：談判不是只提升自己的籌碼。透過發布戰略結盟新聞或發起專利訴訟，合法且精準地削弱對手的替代方案
資訊不對稱 (Information Asymmetry)：刻意隱藏我方的真實底線 (Reservation Price)，同時透過多方管道探測對方的資金斷鏈點，建立不對稱的資訊優勢
en: BATNA (Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement): Before entering the room, we must ruthlessly calculate our BATNA. The mathematical strength of our walk-away option dictates our absolute leverage.

Degrading Opponent's BATNA: Negotiation is not just building our leverage. We will proactively degrade the opponent's alternatives—via strategic press leaks or IP litigation—making their walk-away option toxic.

Information Asymmetry: Ruthlessly guarding our Reservation Price while deploying multi-channel intelligence gathering to pinpoint their liquidity breaking points, establishing an asymmetric advantage.

speaker_notes.zh: 在賽局裡，權力不來自於你的公司規模，而是來自於你的『BATNA (最佳替代方案)』。白話文就是：如果今天談崩了，誰比較不怕死？談判桌下的功夫，比桌上更重要。我們不只要準備好自己的退路，還要透過合法的商業手段（例如放話我們要跟他們的死對頭結盟），去摧毀對手的退路。當對手發現他們沒有其他選擇時，我們就贏了。
speaker_notes.en: In Game Theory, power doesn't stem from market cap; it stems from your 'BATNA'—your Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement. Simply put: if we walk away today, who bleeds more? The war is won before we sit at the table. We don't just build our own alternatives; we actively sabotage theirs through legal, strategic maneuvers (e.g., signaling an alliance with their sworn enemy). When they realize they have no other viable options, we dictate the terms.

slide_title.zh: 非零和賽局與高階調解 (Non-Zero-Sum & Advanced Mediation)

zh: 擴大價值大餅 (Expanding the Pie)：將談判從「你死我活的分配型 (Distributive)」零和遊戲，轉化為「整合型 (Integrative)」非零和賽局，尋找雙方利益的交集點
引入第三方調解 (Third-Party Mediation)：當雙方陷入「膽小鬼博弈 (Game of Chicken)」時，引入專業的商業調解員 (Mediator) 改變賽局結構，提供不失面子的台階
多維度交易 (Multi-issue Trading)：不要只在「價格」上死磕。引入付款條件、技術授權、未來合作權等變數，透過「交換（你拿 A，我拿 B）」達成全局最優解
en: Expanding the Pie (Integrative Bargaining): Forcing the negotiation out of a toxic, 'Distributive' Zero-Sum Game into an 'Integrative' Non-Zero-Sum Game, discovering asymmetrical value intersections.
Third-Party Mediation: When locked in a fatal 'Game of Chicken,' deploying an elite Commercial Mediator physically alters the game's structure, offering a face-saving exit ramp for both parties.

Multi-issue Trading: Refusing to fixate solely on 'Price.' Injecting variables like payment terms, IP licensing, and future ROFRs to execute sophisticated trade-offs (e.g., 'You win on A; we win on B').

speaker_notes.zh: 很多高管把談判當成『零和遊戲』，以為對方賺一塊，我們就虧一塊，這太初階了。真正的大師懂得把餅做大。當我們跟對手像兩台對撞的火車（膽小鬼博弈）時，最好的策略是引入『專業調解員』。調解員的功能不是當和事佬，而是改變這場賽局的結構，讓我們可以不在『價格』上死磕，而是透過交換『付款條件』或『IP 授權』，達成雙贏的非零和結局。
speaker_notes.en: Amateur executives treat negotiations as 'Zero-Sum Games'—believing every dollar the opponent gains is a dollar we lose. Masters expand the pie. When locked in a 'Game of Chicken'—two trains speeding toward collision—the ultimate tactical move is deploying a Professional Mediator. The mediator isn't a peacekeeper; they are a structural architect who alters the game. By expanding variables beyond 'Price' into 'Terms and IP,' we engineer a mutually lucrative Non-Zero-Sum resolution.

slide_title.zh: 可信威脅與承諾機制 (Credible Threats & Commitment)

zh: 燒毀橋樑 (Burning the Bridges)：在談判中，透過公然的「承諾機制 (Commitment Device)」（如：公開宣布絕不降價，或簽署具備高額違約金的排他協議），切斷自己的退路以展現決心
可信威脅 (Credible Threats)：空洞的威脅會被對手看破手腳。威脅必須具備「高昂的執行成本」且「與自動觸發機制綁定」（如：將定價權交給演算法自動對標降價）
以牙還牙策略 (Tit-for-Tat Strategy)：在重複賽局 (Repeated Game) 中，採用「首回合合作，後續複製對手上一回合行為」的策略，建立「不惹事但絕對報復」的強勢人設
en: Burning the Bridges (Commitment Devices): In negotiations, deploying public 'Commitment Devices' (e.g., publicly declaring a price floor, or signing an exclusive contract with heavy penalties) to sever our own retreat, proving absolute resolve.

Credible Threats: Empty threats are instantly exposed. Threats must possess a 'high cost of execution' and be 'auto-triggered' (e.g., hard-coding our pricing algorithm to automatically match and undercut any competitor discount).

Tit-for-Tat Strategy: In 'Repeated Games,' deploying the mathematically proven 'Tit-for-Tat' strategy: cooperate initially, then mirror the opponent's previous move exactly, establishing a persona of 'cooperative but relentlessly retaliatory.'

speaker_notes.zh: 在賽局理論中，『威脅』要有效，你必須證明你是認真的。這叫做『可信威脅』。有時候，展現決心最好的方法是『燒毀自己的橋』。例如，我們公開向媒體宣布『這就是最終報價，絕不妥協』，透過把自己的退路切斷，逼迫對手相信我們真的會離開談判桌。在長期的商業競爭中，我們將貫徹『以牙還牙』策略：你對我好，我就對你好；你敢降價搞我，我一定自動跟進報復。建立這種人設，對手就不敢輕舉妄動。
speaker_notes.en: In Game Theory, for a threat to work, you must mathematically prove you cannot back down. This is a 'Credible Threat.' Sometimes, the most powerful move is 'Burning the Bridges.' By publicly announcing our 'Final Offer' to the press, we sever our own retreat, forcing the opponent to realize we will actually walk away. In long-term market competition, we deploy 'Tit-for-Tat': we cooperate first, but if you attack our pricing, we retaliate automatically and proportionally. Establishing this persona permanently deters aggressive rivals.

slide_title.zh: 100 天談判戰略重構藍圖 (100-Day Negotiation Blueprint)

zh: 第 1-30 天 (籌碼盤點與 BATNA 建構)：針對目前前三大僵局專案，強制要求專案負責人提交量化的 BATNA 分析與對手弱點報告
第 31-100 天 (兵推演練與機制落地)：引入高階商務調解員進行紅軍兵推 (Red Teaming)，並將「非零和交易框架」寫入採購與併購團隊的標準作業流程 (SOP)
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請董事會核准成立「戰略談判與調解中心 (Negotiation & Mediation Hub)」，確保未來所有千萬級交易皆受賽局理論的嚴格檢驗
en: Days 1-30 (Leverage Audit & BATNA Construction): Mandating project leads for our Top 3 deadlocked initiatives to submit quantified BATNA analyses and opponent vulnerability intelligence.

Days 31-100 (War-Gaming & SOP Integration): Deploying elite Commercial Mediators for Red Team war-gaming, and officially embedding 'Non-Zero-Sum' architectural frameworks into Procurement and M&A SOPs.

Call to Action: Requesting Board approval to charter an internal 'Strategic Negotiation & Mediation Hub,' guaranteeing all future 8-figure deals survive rigorous Game Theory stress-testing before execution.

speaker_notes.zh: 這是我們升級談判武力的 100 天藍圖。第一個月，我要看到所有卡關案子的 BATNA 量化報告，我們不打沒退路的仗。接下來的兩個月，我們會進行實兵演練，並讓調解員介入，打破現有的僵局。我懇請董事會授權成立專屬的『談判與調解中心』，未來任何超過千萬的案子，都要用賽局理論算過一遍才能上桌。這將是我們無堅不摧的商業武器。
speaker_notes.en: This is the 100-day blueprint to upgrade our negotiation arsenal. In Month 1, I demand quantified BATNA reports for every deadlocked project; we do not fight without an exit strategy. In Months 2 and 3, we execute live war-gaming and insert Mediators to shatter existing deadlocks. I request the Board authorize a dedicated 'Negotiation & Mediation Hub.' Moving forward, no 8-figure deal reaches the table without rigorous Game Theory validation. This is our ultimate commercial weapon.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『賽局理論與戰略談判』簡報。受眾為董事會、CEO 或核心談判團隊。內容必須展現結合經濟學、法理學與高階調解 (Mediation) 的頂級博弈視野：1. 運用 SCQA 點出『囚徒困境』帶來的毀滅性競爭與納許均衡死結，2. 探討如何精算並提升我方 BATNA (最佳替代方案)，同時合法摧毀對手的退路，3. 導入高階商業調解員 (Mediator) 的視角，將零和遊戲轉化為『擴大價值』的非零和賽局，4. 解析『可信威脅』、『承諾機制 (燒毀橋樑)』與『以牙還牙』策略在重複賽局中的震懾力，5. 結尾給出 100 天談判重構藍圖，要求成立專屬談判與調解中心。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需極具數學嚴謹度、冷酷的談判手腕與運籌帷幄的戰略高度。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Game Theory & Asymmetric Negotiation' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors, CEO, or the Core Negotiation Team. Demonstrate the elite integration of economics, jurisprudence, and advanced Mediation: 1. Use SCQA to frame the destructive attrition of a 'Prisoner's Dilemma' and toxic Nash Equilibriums. 2. Detail the rigorous calculation of BATNA and the strategic degradation of the opponent's alternatives. 3. Integrate the perspective of an Elite Commercial Mediator, structurally pivoting 'Zero-Sum' battles into value-expanding 'Non-Zero-Sum' integrative solutions. 4. Dissect the psychological deterrence of 'Credible Threats,' 'Commitment Devices (Burning Bridges),' and 'Tit-for-Tat' in repeated games. 5. Conclude with a 100-Day Negotiation Rewire Blueprint, demanding the charter of an internal Mediation Hub. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must project mathematical inevitability, clinical negotiation mastery, and supreme strategic command.
